package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestSchema = "teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1"
	TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffSchema        = "teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1"
	TeacherOnboardingHandoffAccepted          = "ACCEPTED"
	TeacherOnboardingExecutionNotStarted      = "NOT_STARTED"
)

var (
	ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable     = errors.New("teacher onboarding plan handoff unavailable")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict        = errors.New("teacher onboarding plan handoff conflict")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffStateChanged    = errors.New("teacher onboarding plan handoff state changed")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffActivePath      = errors.New("teacher onboarding plan handoff active path exists")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffRejected        = errors.New("teacher onboarding plan handoff rejected")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse = errors.New("teacher onboarding plan handoff invalid response")
)

type TeacherOnboardingHandoffStatus string

const (
	TeacherOnboardingHandoffQueued         TeacherOnboardingHandoffStatus = "queued"
	TeacherOnboardingHandoffDispatching    TeacherOnboardingHandoffStatus = "dispatching"
	TeacherOnboardingHandoffAcceptedStatus TeacherOnboardingHandoffStatus = "accepted"
	TeacherOnboardingHandoffMessagePending TeacherOnboardingHandoffStatus = "message_pending"
	TeacherOnboardingHandoffDelivered      TeacherOnboardingHandoffStatus = "delivered"
	TeacherOnboardingHandoffActivePath     TeacherOnboardingHandoffStatus = "active_path"
	TeacherOnboardingHandoffBlocked        TeacherOnboardingHandoffStatus = "blocked"
)

type TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest struct {
	Schema           string                          `json:"schema"`
	ExpectedStateRef TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef `json:"expected_state_ref"`
	DialogID         string                          `json:"dialog_id"`
	TeacherJobID     string                          `json:"teacher_job_id"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff struct {
	Schema              string                          `json:"schema"`
	HandoffID           string                          `json:"handoff_id"`
	Status              string                          `json:"status"`
	StateRef            TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef `json:"state_ref"`
	Goal                TeacherLearningReadinessGoal    `json:"goal"`
	ExecutionStatus     string                          `json:"execution_status"`
	ContentStatus       string                          `json:"content_status"`
	ReadinessObservedAt string                          `json:"readiness_observed_at"`
	Replayed            bool                            `json:"replayed"`
}

// TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent is the bounded Teacher-owned delivery ledger.
// It stores only exact identities and the server-owned READY goal tuple. It
// never stores a Student profile, Planner graph payload, prompt, or message body.
type TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent struct {
	ID                    string
	StudentID             string
	PersonalTeacherID     string
	DialogID              string
	SourceTeacherJobID    string
	SourceInteractionID   string
	CommandID             string
	CommandTeacherJobID   string
	RequestHash           string
	StateRef              TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef
	Goal                  TeacherLearningReadinessGoal
	Locale                string
	Status                TeacherOnboardingHandoffStatus
	ClaimToken            string
	LockedBy              string
	LockedUntil           time.Time
	Attempts              int
	NextAttemptAt         time.Time
	PlannerHandoffID      string
	NotificationCommandID string
	NotificationMessageID string
	LastErrorCode         string
	CreatedAt             time.Time
	UpdatedAt             time.Time
	AcceptedAt            time.Time
	ReadinessObservedAt   time.Time
	DeliveredAt           time.Time
	SourceRequest         *DialogTeacherRequest
}

func BuildTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(teacher PersonalTeacher, binding TeacherDialogBinding, readiness TeacherLearningReadiness, locale, sourceTeacherJobID, sourceInteractionID string, now time.Time) (TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, error) {
	binding, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(binding)
	readiness, readinessErr := NormalizeTeacherLearningReadiness(readiness, &readiness.StateRef)
	if err != nil || readinessErr != nil || readiness.Result != TeacherLearningReadinessReady || readiness.Goal == nil ||
		teacher.ID != binding.PersonalTeacherID || teacher.StudentID != binding.StudentID || now.IsZero() {
		return TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	identity := []any{teacher.StudentID, readiness.StateRef.Kind, readiness.StateRef.Version}
	intent := TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{
		ID: DeterministicOnboardingUUID("planner-handoff-intent", identity...), StudentID: teacher.StudentID,
		PersonalTeacherID: teacher.ID, DialogID: binding.ID, SourceTeacherJobID: sourceTeacherJobID, SourceInteractionID: sourceInteractionID,
		CommandID:           DeterministicOnboardingUUID("planner-handoff-command", identity...),
		CommandTeacherJobID: DeterministicOnboardingUUID("planner-handoff-teacher-job", identity...),
		StateRef:            readiness.StateRef, Goal: *readiness.Goal, Locale: locale, Status: TeacherOnboardingHandoffQueued,
		NextAttemptAt: now.UTC(), NotificationCommandID: DeterministicOnboardingUUID("planner-handoff-notification", identity...),
		CreatedAt: now.UTC(), UpdatedAt: now.UTC(),
	}
	request, err := NewTeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest(intentWithProvisionalHash(intent))
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, err
	}
	intent.RequestHash, err = TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestHash(intent.StudentID, request)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, err
	}
	return NewTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(intent)
}

func intentWithProvisionalHash(intent TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent {
	intent.RequestHash = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
	return intent
}

func NewTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(input TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) (TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, error) {
	for field := range map[*string]struct{}{
		&input.ID: {}, &input.StudentID: {}, &input.PersonalTeacherID: {}, &input.DialogID: {},
		&input.SourceTeacherJobID: {}, &input.SourceInteractionID: {}, &input.CommandID: {},
		&input.CommandTeacherJobID: {}, &input.RequestHash: {}, &input.PlannerHandoffID: {},
		&input.NotificationCommandID: {}, &input.NotificationMessageID: {}, &input.LastErrorCode: {}, &input.LockedBy: {},
	} {
		*field = strings.TrimSpace(*field)
	}
	input.RequestHash = strings.ToLower(input.RequestHash)
	input.Locale = strings.TrimSpace(input.Locale)
	if input.Locale != "en" {
		input.Locale = "ru"
	}
	input.CreatedAt = input.CreatedAt.UTC()
	input.UpdatedAt = input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	input.NextAttemptAt = input.NextAttemptAt.UTC()
	input.LockedUntil = input.LockedUntil.UTC()
	input.AcceptedAt = input.AcceptedAt.UTC()
	input.ReadinessObservedAt = input.ReadinessObservedAt.UTC()
	input.DeliveredAt = input.DeliveredAt.UTC()
	stateRef, refErr := NormalizeTeacherStudentReadinessStateRef(input.StateRef)
	if refErr != nil || stateRef.Kind == TeacherReadinessStateNone || !validReadyGoalForHandoff(input.Goal) ||
		!validUUID(input.ID) || !validUUID(input.StudentID) || !validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) || !validUUID(input.DialogID) ||
		!validUUID(input.CommandID) || !validUUID(input.CommandTeacherJobID) || !validUUID(input.NotificationCommandID) ||
		(input.SourceTeacherJobID != "" && !validUUID(input.SourceTeacherJobID)) ||
		(input.SourceInteractionID != "" && !validUUID(input.SourceInteractionID)) ||
		(input.SourceTeacherJobID == "") != (input.SourceInteractionID == "") ||
		(input.PlannerHandoffID != "" && !validUUID(input.PlannerHandoffID)) ||
		(input.NotificationMessageID != "" && !validUUID(input.NotificationMessageID)) ||
		len(input.RequestHash) != 64 || !lowerHex(input.RequestHash) || input.Attempts < 0 ||
		input.CreatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.Before(input.CreatedAt) || input.NextAttemptAt.IsZero() ||
		len(input.LastErrorCode) > 64 || len(input.LockedBy) > 128 ||
		(input.PlannerHandoffID == "") != input.AcceptedAt.IsZero() || (input.PlannerHandoffID == "") != input.ReadinessObservedAt.IsZero() {
		return TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	input.StateRef = stateRef
	switch input.Status {
	case TeacherOnboardingHandoffQueued:
		if input.ClaimToken != "" || input.LockedBy != "" || !input.LockedUntil.IsZero() || input.PlannerHandoffID != "" || input.NotificationMessageID != "" || !input.AcceptedAt.IsZero() || !input.ReadinessObservedAt.IsZero() || !input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() {
			return TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingHandoffDispatching:
		if !validUUID(input.ClaimToken) || input.LockedBy == "" || input.LockedUntil.IsZero() || input.PlannerHandoffID != "" || input.NotificationMessageID != "" || !input.AcceptedAt.IsZero() || !input.ReadinessObservedAt.IsZero() || !input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() {
			return TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingHandoffAcceptedStatus:
		if input.ClaimToken != "" || input.LockedBy != "" || !input.LockedUntil.IsZero() || !validUUID(input.PlannerHandoffID) || input.NotificationMessageID != "" || input.AcceptedAt.IsZero() || input.ReadinessObservedAt.IsZero() || !input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() {
			return TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingHandoffMessagePending:
		if !validUUID(input.ClaimToken) || input.LockedBy == "" || input.LockedUntil.IsZero() || input.NotificationMessageID != "" || !input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() ||
			(input.PlannerHandoffID == "") != input.AcceptedAt.IsZero() || (input.PlannerHandoffID == "") != input.ReadinessObservedAt.IsZero() {
			return TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingHandoffDelivered:
		if input.ClaimToken != "" || input.LockedBy != "" || !input.LockedUntil.IsZero() || !validUUID(input.NotificationMessageID) || input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() ||
			(input.PlannerHandoffID == "") != input.AcceptedAt.IsZero() || (input.PlannerHandoffID == "") != input.ReadinessObservedAt.IsZero() {
			return TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingHandoffActivePath:
		if input.ClaimToken != "" || input.LockedBy != "" || !input.LockedUntil.IsZero() || input.PlannerHandoffID != "" || !input.AcceptedAt.IsZero() || !input.ReadinessObservedAt.IsZero() || input.NotificationMessageID != "" || !input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() {
			return TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingHandoffBlocked:
		if input.ClaimToken != "" || input.LockedBy != "" || !input.LockedUntil.IsZero() || input.LastErrorCode == "" || !input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() {
			return TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	default:
		return TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return input, nil
}

func NewTeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest(intent TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) (TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest, error) {
	intent, err := NewTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(intent)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest{}, err
	}
	return TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest{
		Schema: TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestSchema, ExpectedStateRef: intent.StateRef,
		DialogID: intent.DialogID, TeacherJobID: intent.CommandTeacherJobID,
	}, nil
}

func TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestHash(studentID string, request TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest) (string, error) {
	if !validUUID(studentID) || request.Schema != TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestSchema || !validUUID(request.DialogID) || !validUUID(request.TeacherJobID) {
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if _, err := NormalizeTeacherStudentReadinessStateRef(request.ExpectedStateRef); err != nil || request.ExpectedStateRef.Kind == TeacherReadinessStateNone {
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		StudentID string                              `json:"student_id"`
		Request   TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest `json:"request"`
	}{StudentID: studentID, Request: request})
	if err != nil {
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), nil
}

func NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff(input TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff, intent TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) (TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff, error) {
	intent, intentErr := NewTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(intent)
	stateRef, refErr := NormalizeTeacherStudentReadinessStateRef(input.StateRef)
	if intentErr != nil || refErr != nil || input.Schema != TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffSchema || !validUUID(input.HandoffID) ||
		input.Status != TeacherOnboardingHandoffAccepted || stateRef != intent.StateRef || input.Goal != intent.Goal ||
		input.ExecutionStatus != TeacherOnboardingExecutionNotStarted || input.ContentStatus != TeacherLearningContentNotCreated || !canonicalHandoffTimestamp(input.ReadinessObservedAt) {
		return TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
	}
	input.StateRef = stateRef
	return input, nil
}

func canonicalHandoffTimestamp(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, value)
	return err == nil && strings.HasSuffix(value, "Z") && parsed.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano) == value
}

func TeacherOnboardingHandoffDisplayName(goal TeacherLearningReadinessGoal) (string, error) {
	switch goal {
	case (TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{Code: TeacherFoundationGoalCode, Version: TeacherFoundationGoalVersion, GraphVersion: TeacherFoundationGraphVersion}):
		return TeacherFoundationGoalDisplayName, nil
	case (TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{Code: TeacherGoBackendGoalCode, Version: TeacherGoBackendGoalVersion, GraphVersion: TeacherGoBackendGraphVersion}):
		return TeacherGoBackendGoalDisplayName, nil
	default:
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
}

func TeacherOnboardingHandoffAcceptedBody(locale, displayName string) (string, error) {
	if displayName != TeacherFoundationGoalDisplayName && displayName != TeacherGoBackendGoalDisplayName {
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if locale == "en" {
		return "Your “" + displayName + "” learning plan request has been accepted. Preparation has not started yet; no course, path, or lessons have been created.", nil
	}
	return "Запрос на подготовку пути «" + displayName + "» принят. Подготовка ещё не началась; курс, путь и уроки не созданы.", nil
}

func TeacherOnboardingHandoffActivePathBody(locale string) string {
	if locale == "en" {
		return "Your existing learning path is preserved unchanged. No new path, course, or lessons have been created."
	}
	return "Ваш существующий учебный путь сохранён без изменений. Новый путь, курс или уроки не создавались."
}

func validReadyGoalForHandoff(goal TeacherLearningReadinessGoal) bool {
	return validReadyGoal(TeacherReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved, goal) || validReadyGoal(TeacherReadinessReasonGoBackendGraphResolved, goal)
}

func lowerHex(value string) bool {
	for _, current := range value {
		if (current < '0' || current > '9') && (current < 'a' || current > 'f') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
